class Greeter extends Base
  constructor: (@name = "world") ->
    super()

  greet: (times = 1) =>
    text = "Hello, #{@name}! Count: #{times + 1}\n"
    raw = 'single #{not}'
    pattern = /\d+ "quoted"/i
    (text for i in [1..times]).join('') unless no

greeter = new Greeter 'coffee'
console.log greeter.greet(2), 0x1F, null, undefined, yes
